mapper.sql: SELECT p.id AS patientId, p.study_no AS studyNo, p.name, p.gender, p.age, YEAR(COALESCE(p.create_date, p.createDate)) AS createYear, p.follow_cycle AS followCycle, IFNULL(v.visitCount, 0) AS visitCount, v.lastVisit, CASE WHEN w.patient_id IS NULL AND v.lastVisit IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_ADD(DATE(v.lastVisit), INTERVAL p.follow_cycle MONTH) END AS nextDue, CASE WHEN w.patient_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'withdrawn' WHEN IFNULL(v.visitCount, 0) = 0 THEN 'pending_first' WHEN DATE_ADD(DATE(v.lastVisit), INTERVAL p.follow_cycle MONTH) < CURDATE() THEN 'overdue' WHEN DATE_ADD(DATE(v.lastVisit), INTERVAL p.follow_cycle MONTH) <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 14 DAY) THEN 'soon' ELSE 'active' END AS followStatus, q.missingCodes FROM patient_basic_info p JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM patient_relation_doctor WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId}) d ON d.patient_id = p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM patient_relation_doctor WHERE miss = 1) w ON w.patient_id = p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT f.patient_basic_info_id AS pid, COUNT(*) AS visitCount, MAX(COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate)) AS lastVisit FROM patient_follow_up_history f GROUP BY f.patient_basic_info_id) v ON v.pid = p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.patient_id, GROUP_CONCAT(t.rule_code ORDER BY t.rule_code) AS missingCodes FROM () t WHERE t.rule_code LIKE 'M\_%' GROUP BY t.patient_id) q ON q.patient_id = p.id

where.if: AND (x.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(x.patientId AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR x.studyNo LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalPatients, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN x.missingCodes IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS incompleteCount FROM () x

SELECT x.patientId, x.studyNo, x.name, x.gender, x.age, x.createYear, x.followCycle, x.visitCount, DATE_FORMAT(x.lastVisit, '%Y-%m-%d') AS lastVisitDate, DATE_FORMAT(x.nextDue, '%Y-%m-%d') AS nextDueDate, x.followStatus, x.missingCodes FROM () x
ORDER BY x.lastVisit IS NULL, x.lastVisit DESC, x.patientId DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT patient_id AS patientId, disease_code AS code, since_year AS sinceYear FROM patient_comorbidity WHERE patient_id IN #{id} ORDER BY patient_id, id
